events.title: Fibonacci International Olympiad - Bangladesh National Round 2026
events.description:
Why Bangladesh recently delivered the Bangladesh National Round of the Fibonacci International Olympiad, bringing together young problem-solvers for a national-level academic competition and celebration of talent.

Chief Guest: Md. Nurul Hoque, State Minister for Expatriates’ Welfare and Overseas Employment, Government of Bangladesh
